_comment: MCP servers are OPTIONAL. CCM works without them. Skills that depend on these MCPs degrade gracefully (e.g., arib-memory-search falls back to grep on memory/*.md when claude-mem is unavailable). Package names verified against npm 2026-05-08 — see _package_status per entry. ALWAYS re-verify before relying in production.

github._purpose: Standard Model Context Protocol GitHub server.

claude-mem._purpose: Item #3 — semantic memory layer. Falls back to markdown grep if absent.
claude-mem._package_status: Real upstream is the unscoped 'claude-mem' package (https://www.npmjs.com/package/claude-mem). Args updated accordingly. Verify CLI surface matches scripts/memory-export.sh expectations.

cowork._purpose: Item #4 — push-based I/O transport. Falls back to filesystem polling.
cowork._package_status: PLACEHOLDER. No npm package matches @anthropic/cowork-mcp as of 2026-05-08. CCM falls back to CCM_NOTIFY_WEBHOOK / CCM_COWORK_WEBHOOK env vars regardless. If/when an MCP package ships, update args here.

testsprite._purpose: Item #9 — cloud test execution gate. arib-check-deploy degrades to local checks if absent.
